full_query: So what does the non reactive mean for the hep a igm

shared_context.topic: interpretation of a non-reactive Hepatitis A IgM result

sentences: A non-reactive result for the Hepatitis A IgM antibody test indicates that there is no detectable level of IgM antibodies against the Hepatitis A virus in the blood sample
This typically means that the individual has not been recently infected with the Hepatitis A virus, as IgM antibodies are usually present during an acute or recent infection

snippets.output: A non-reactive Hepatitis A IgM antibody test means there is no detectable level of IgM antibodies against the Hepatitis A virus in the blood sample and typically indicates that the individual has not been recently infected with the Hepatitis A virus, because IgM antibodies are usually present during an acute or recent infection.
